test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

How many sums __had you solve__ so far?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Have you solved'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As the sentence is a **perfect tense**, the formula for the **perfect tense** is **had/have/has + [past participle**]. 
 
• So, the verb **solve **should be replaced with **solved**.
 
• Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer.

**The correct sentence is: **How many sums*** have you solved*** so far?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Past Perfect Tense:**

 
• The **past perfect tense** is for talking about something that happened before something else in the past.

 
 
• I turned back to the house and saw that someone named Tootles **had **defaced my front door!
